name: Homemade Maple Pork Breakfast Sausage Patties with Fruit Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place pork, maple syrup, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Form the pork mixture into twelve ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g lean ground pork
pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add sausage patties and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (454 g) pkg strawberries
1 banana
1 (170 g) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice strawberries. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Peel banana and cut in half lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the strawberries, along with blueberries, and stir to combine the fruit salad.
To serve, divide sausage patties and fruit salad between plates. Drizzle sausages with additional maple syrup (if desired) and enjoy!
